questionText: [Set 39.26] The postfix (Reverse Polish Notation) equivalent of the infix arithmetic expression `(A + B) * C` is:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT principles for Section B1: Computer Science Core (Infix to Postfix Conversion):
A B + C *

Detailed Context:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Computer_Science (Data Structures: Stacks - Infix to Postfix Conversion):
Evaluating with operator precedence: inner parentheses `(A + B)` becomes `AB+`. Multiplying by `C` yields `AB+ C *`.

Hence, Option (A) is the correct answer.

Therefore, option (B) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Match the Bubble Sort complexity scenario in List I with its metric in List II for an array of n elements:

List I:
(A) Worst-case Time Complexity
(B) Best-case Time Complexity (Optimized)
(C) Average-case Time Complexity
(D) Auxiliary Space Complexity

List II:
(I) O(n²) (reverse sorted array requiring n(n-1)/2 swaps)
(II) O(n) (already sorted array terminating after 1 pass)
(III) O(n²)
(IV) O(1) (in-place sorting requiring no extra memory)

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Correctly maps each entity across columns.
Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Worst is O(n²); Optimized best is O(n); Average is O(n²); Auxiliary space is O(1) in-place.
Hence Option B is correct.
Hence, option (A) is the correct match.
